title: EvaluateOutput (Socratic Educator -> Profiling/XAI)
description: Structured record produced at the end of every dialogue session. Enumerated/boolean fields only (no free text about the conversation itself) so Component 4 can cluster and report without re-parsing natural language.

self_regulation_shown.description: Did the child articulate their own safer alternative during Inquire?

escalation_flag.description: True if Contract state determined this session needs parent review

dialogue_summary.description: Short, redacted, parent-safe summary. Never contains the raw flagged content.
